text: Coffee with Mila after work. She's 20 weeks now and they found out it's a girl. Her husband Matteo is painting the nursery this weekend and apparently hates every shade of yellow. Due date is March 3rd.

Long catch-up with Patrick on the phone. He's got back into chess properly, plays on Lichess most nights and has a club tournament on November 8. His daughter Ava starts swimming lessons next month. Remind me to text him good luck the day before the tournament.

Agnieszka Nowak came round with the baby! Little Zofia was born September 29 and is already a chunky thing. Agnieszka says she's barely sleeping but managing. Her mum flies over from Kraków on 2 November 2026 to help out for a month.

Lior's christening plans: the baby's being christened on Dec 6 at St Mary's, lunch after at his in-laws'. He asked if I'd be a godparent. I'm saying yes obviously. Need to sort a christening gift the week before, maybe a silver bracelet.

Neha's into pottery now, wheel throwing every Tuesday. Wants a kiln eventually but her flat's too small. She mentioned that glaze set she keeps looking at, could be a good birthday present. Her birthday is 4/17.
Bridget rang. Her sister Kerry is expecting again, number three, due in June. Bridget's going to be useless with excitement. Kerry's been sick as a dog in the mornings though.
Quick one: Aneesh's baby shower is cancelled, his wife Tanvi was put on bed rest. They're doing a small thing at home once the baby's here instead. Should check in on Tanvi later this week.
Pick up dry cleaning, renew car tax before the 31st, book the boiler service.
Fern supports Leeds United, has done since she was six, and goes to every home game with her dad. Season ticket holder. Don't mention the 2019 play-offs, apparently still a sore point.

Met Sophie Hughes for lunch. Her son Elijah has his grade 3 piano exam on May 14, he's practising scales every evening and is pretty nervous. Sophie says he wants to do jazz next. Remind me to message her that evening to see how it went.

Barbara is learning to knit for her first grandchild, her daughter Esther is due on January 22nd. She's halfway through a cardigan, lemon yellow, and has dropped about forty stitches. Esther's having the baby at the Royal, booked for a planned C section. Remind me to send flowers the week after.
Ivan told me he and Olivia got engaged in Lisbon! Wedding probably summer 2027. He's been learning Portuguese on Duolingo for a year so he could propose in it.
Tobi's band is playing the Fleece on June 3rd, he's on bass. They've been rehearsing twice a week. Bilal and I are going together. Get tickets this week before they sell out.
Joy said Salma had the baby last night, a boy, 7lb 2oz, both doing fine. Name still undecided. Must get a card and a little something for him before I see her on Sunday.
Farid is obsessed with board games at the moment, Wingspan and Ark Nova mostly. Has a shelf of about 80. Hosts a games night first Friday of every month. Wants the Wingspan expansion for Christmas.
Talked with Alessia about her cat Biscotto, he needs a dental op on October 28. She's worried because he's 14. Remind me to ask how he got on the day after.
Matteo mentioned his brother Joseph is moving to Manchester in March 2027 for a new job at the BBC. Joseph's partner is staying in Bristol for now, long distance for a bit.
Anika's first scan is next Thursday, 12 weeks. Only told family and me so far. She's nervous after last time. Don't forget to text her that morning.
Mabel's got really into birdwatching since retiring. She drove to Norfolk for a week in August and saw a bittern. Now saving up for proper binoculars, Swarovski ones, which cost a fortune.

Dinner with Ben and Ifeoma. They're expecting twins, due around 7/9! Ifeoma has gestational diabetes so she's being monitored every two weeks, and she's off sugar entirely, which she says is the worst part. Ben is panicking about the car, they'll need a bigger one. Ben's mum is moving in for the first month. Gender reveal party on August 15 at their place, I'm bringing dessert (something sugar free for Ifeoma). Remind me to order the cake the day before.
Kerry said her daughter is starting nursery on Jan 5. Kerry's back at work two weeks later and dreading it.
Aidan plays in a five-a-side league Wednesdays, captain of the team. He tore his calf a fortnight ago so he's coaching from the side until December.
Ring Esther on her birthday, November 19.

Elijah Tanaka from work is a huge Studio Ghibli fan, has all the films on Blu-ray and the soundtrack vinyls. His wife Mabel collects Totoro plushies. They're both going to the Ghibli exhibition in London on Feb 12, 2027.

Patrick and his wife Bridget renewed their vows last weekend for their 25th anniversary, in the same church they got married in. Their kids organised a surprise party afterwards. Patrick cried through the whole thing apparently. I should send them a card even though it's late.
Agnieszka says the baby's christening is booked for April 12, 2027, back in Poland. Whole family flying out. She's stressed about the baby's passport arriving in time.

Tanvi had her baby girl on Monday, Mira. Bit early, in special care for a few days but doing well now. Aneesh sounds exhausted. Remind me to drop round food on the weekend, and check with Aneesh before so I don't turn up at a bad time.

Went for a walk with Ava. Her husband Lior has started marathon training for Berlin on September 26, 2027. He runs five days a week now. Ava's taken up crochet to cope with the evenings alone. She's making amigurumi animals for her niece.
Haircut moved to Thursday 3pm. Also gym induction on 11/2.

Olivia finished her PhD viva yesterday, passed with minor corrections! Graduation is in July. She's off to Japan for three weeks in December to celebrate. Need to get her something, she loves fountain pens.

Spoke to Salma about the baby's christening, it's on 3/21 at her parents' church in Leicester, and she asked me to do a reading. Her husband Farid is doing the slideshow. I should practise the reading the week before and confirm with Salma the day after I get the text.
Joseph's mum passed away last Tuesday. Funeral is November 4. He seemed okay on the phone but quiet. Check in on him a few days after the funeral.
Bilal follows the NBA religiously, Celtics fan, stays up till 3am for games. He's going to Boston in April 2027 to see them play at home. Has a signed Tatum jersey framed in his hallway.

Catch up with Ifeoma: twins arrived early, both girls, in NICU for now. She's tired but in good spirits. Ben's on paternity leave until October 30. Remind me to send a care package the week they come home.
Neha's brother Aidan got into Edinburgh for medicine, starts in September. Their parents are thrilled. Neha's dog Pickle is getting old and she's dreading the vet appointment on May 2.
Fern and her boyfriend Tobi are off to Iceland on 12/10 for their anniversary. She's hoping for the northern lights. Tobi's planning to propose, she has no idea! Don't say a word.
Sophie's 40th is August 22. She's having a garden party, her partner Ivan is doing a pig roast. She said she'd love a hammock for the garden, hint hint.
Mila sent pictures, baby girl Rosa born on March 1st, two days early. Matteo has gone full proud dad. Christening likely in the summer. Remind me to send a gift the week after they're home.

Joy is three months pregnant, finally told me. Due date 22 May 2027. She's had awful morning sickness and is off coffee, which is killing her. Her partner Elijah doesn't know how to help. She's nervous about telling her boss next week. I need to message her the evening after she tells him, see how it went.

Called Uncle Ivan. He's restoring an old MG in his garage, 1972 model, sourcing parts off eBay. Classic car show in Goodwood on 7/18 he wants to enter it in if it's running. His knee replacement is on June 2nd so it might be tight.

Barbara mentioned her granddaughter's christening was lovely, little Ada. Esther wore her own christening gown from 1989. I sent a card already. Barbara's next project is a christening blanket for her nephew's baby, due in the spring.

Kerry's into wild swimming, goes to the lido every morning even in January. Her husband Matteo thinks she's mad. She's doing a sponsored swim on 15 February 2027 for the hospice where her dad was. Sponsor her the week before.
Mabel says the book club is reading Wolf Hall next. Meeting on Nov 12 at hers.

Tanvi's sister Anika is expecting too, due May 30th. Cousins only months apart. Their mum is over the moon, keeps knitting tiny hats. Anika lives in Leeds so Tanvi's driving up on 4/5 for the baby shower. I'm staying in with Mira that weekend.

Alessia Garcia is learning the cello at 35, lessons every Saturday with a retired orchestra player. She's doing her first adult recital on June 14th and is terrified. Text her good luck that morning, and ask how it went the next day.
Must book the restaurant for Mum's birthday dinner on November 23.
Lior said Ben's wife is pregnant, due around March 2027. Ben hasn't said anything to me yet so I'll play dumb.
Ifeoma (Ify) started a sourdough obsession during maternity leave, has a starter called Doughlores. Sells loaves to the neighbours on Saturdays. Her twins are napping better now, finally.

Esther's back at work from maternity leave on January 8, 2027, part time three days a week. Her husband Bilal takes Fridays off. The baby's starting at a childminder the week before. She's worried about the settling in. I should check in with her that first evening.
Chat with Farid at the school gate. His son Tobi is in the under 11s rugby team, they've got a county final on 3/14. Farid's coaching. Their other son has his first Holy Communion in May.
Aneesh plays cricket for the village team every Sunday in summer, opening bat. Winter he's doing indoor nets. He's also into fantasy football, top of our work league.

Long call with Agnieszka. Baby Zofia's sleeping five hours straight now. Agnieszka's thinking of going back to work at the bank in March 2027 but might extend leave. Her husband Patrick has gone back to climbing on weekends. Their cat Pierogi has taken to sleeping under the cot. Remind me to ring her the week after she decides.
Note to self: post Joy's baby card on Friday.

Olivia (Liv) Sato is huge into K-pop, BTS mostly, has seen them live three times. Her sister Ava is taking her to the reunion show in Seoul on Oct 3, 2027 for her 30th. Ava asked me to chip in for the flights.

Patrick's daughter Ava had her first communion on Sunday, then a big lunch at the golf club. He showed me photos. Ava's into gymnastics, competing at regionals on 5/22. Remind me to send Ava a little good luck card the day before.

Bridget's husband Aidan was made redundant last month. He's applying everywhere, interview on Nov 6 with an engineering firm. He's struggling with it more than he lets on. Bridget's picked up extra shifts. Need to call Aidan the evening after the interview.
Saw Sophie and Ivan at the park with the new puppy, a cockapoo called Waffles. Sophie's pregnant, 16 weeks, due April 9th. They're moving to a bigger house in January, completion on Jan 20.

Neha said Kerry's baby shower was moved to 11/29 because of the hen do. Kerry's hen is November 15 in Bath. Neha's organising both, poor thing, and is frazzled. Offer to help with decorations the week before the shower.
Elijah is training for his black belt grading in karate on February 28, 2027. Practising kata in the kitchen every night. His wife Joy filmed him for me. He's nervous, he failed it last year.

Matteo's daughter Mila is starting university in September 2027, wants to study marine biology in Plymouth. She's a mad diver and got her PADI advanced over the summer. Matteo's dreading the empty nest already.
